_readme: The credits screen, driven by real keys, from the title row a player presses.
It is in tools/pack_check.sh's list as well as check.sh's, and that is the point of it.
credits.json is generated art metadata that ships inside the .pck, and the whole class of
defect this feature can have is 'the file did not get packed' - which every gate running
against res:// is structurally blind to. M14 shipped exactly that: the audio seam's
drop-in half was broken in exports for milestones with every gate green.
Paging is asserted by the SOUND, not by a page number: the cue is the only thing a
session can see, and it is emitted only when the page actually turned.

steps.text: the title, with nothing saved, so the cursor opens on New game. Rows: Continue, New game, Credits - so Credits is one move_down.
turn a page. The move cue is what proves it turned: the screen is silent when there is nowhere to turn to, so a one-page screen would fail here rather than pass quietly.
and back, which is the same cue in the other direction - the artists are several pages deep and a player must be able to return to the notice that says what they are a list of
leave. The title is still behind it and still answers, which is what a screen that latched its answer on the way out would fail.
up onto New game from Credits, and the run begins - the title was not left deaf by the visit
